# `color` standard library

The `color` module provides color representations, conversions between common color spaces
(sRGB, Linear sRGB, Oklab, Oklch, HSV), alpha compositing, and hex packing/unpacking.

```dva
#use color
```

## Color spaces and data types

All color spaces in `color` are represented by normalized 4-float records `(Float, Float, Float, Float)`
where the fourth component represents alpha ($0.0 \dots 1.0$). This layout leverages element-wise
vector operations (`+`, `-`, `*`).

| Type | Components | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `color::Rgba` | `(r, g, b, a)` | Standard non-linear sRGB with alpha |
| `color::LinearRgba` | `(r, g, b, a)` | Radiometrically linear sRGB |
| `color::Oklab` | `(l, a, b, alpha)` | Perceptually uniform Oklab color space |
| `color::Oklch` | `(l, c, h, alpha)` | Cylindrical Oklch (Lightness, Chroma, Hue in radians) |
| `color::Hsv` | `(h, s, v, alpha)` | Hue, Saturation, Value |

## Constructors and hex conversions

```dva
c1 = color::rgba(0.2, 0.4, 0.8, 1.0)
c2 = color::rgb(1.0, 0.5, 0.0)             // Defaults alpha to 1.0
hex_color = color::from_hex(0xFF00AAFF)     // Unpack 0xRRGGBBAA
val = color::to_hex(c1)                    // Pack to 0xRRGGBBAA
```

## Transformations and blending

| Function | Signature | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `color::srgb_to_linear` | `Rgba => LinearRgba` | Converts sRGB gamma to linear space |
| `color::linear_to_srgb` | `LinearRgba => Rgba` | Encodes linear sRGB to gamma-corrected sRGB |
| `color::rgb_to_oklab` | `Rgba => Oklab` | Converts sRGB to perceptually uniform Oklab |
| `color::oklab_to_rgb` | `Oklab => Rgba` | Converts Oklab back to sRGB |
| `color::oklab_to_oklch` | `Oklab => Oklch` | Converts Cartesian Oklab to polar Oklch |
| `color::oklch_to_oklab` | `Oklch => Oklab` | Converts polar Oklch to Cartesian Oklab |
| `color::rgb_to_hsv` | `Rgba => Hsv` | Converts sRGB to HSV |
| `color::hsv_to_rgb` | `Hsv => Rgba` | Converts HSV to sRGB |
| `color::over` | `Rgba, Rgba => Rgba` | Porter-Duff source-over alpha compositing |
| `color::mix` | `Rgba, Rgba, Float => Rgba` | Linear interpolation in sRGB space |
| `color::mix_oklab` | `Rgba, Rgba, Float => Rgba` | Perceptually uniform color interpolation |
